key: My husband was looking for you.
en: My husband was looking for you.
ja: うちの主人が、あなたを探していましたよ。

key: I'm the Day-Care Lady.
en: I'm the Day-Care Lady.
ja: わたしは預かり屋のおばさんです。

key: We can raise Pokémon for you.
en: We can raise Pokémon for you.
ja: ポケモンを預かって育てて差し上げますよ。

key: Would you like us to raise one?
en: Would you like us to raise one?
ja: 一匹、預けてみますか?

key: Oh? But you have just one Pokémon.
en: Oh?  But you have just one Pokémon.
ja: あら? でも、ポケモンが一匹しかいませんね。

key: Come back another time.
en: Come back another time.
ja: また今度、いらしてくださいね。

key: Which Pokémon should we raise for you?
en: Which Pokémon should we raise for you?
ja: どのポケモンを預かりましょうか?

key: Fine. Come again.
en: Fine. Come again.
ja: わかりました。またお越しくださいね。

key: I'm afraid that Pokémon is actually an Egg.
en: I'm afraid that Pokémon is actually an Egg.
ja: 申し訳ありませんが、そのポケモンは実はたまごなんですよ。

key: If you leave me that Pokémon, what will you battle with?
en: If you leave me that Pokémon, what will you battle with?
ja: そのポケモンを預けてしまったら、何でバトルするんですか?

key: Fine, we'll raise your \v[3] for a while.
en: Fine, we'll raise your \v[3] for a while.
ja: わかりました。しばらく\v[3]をお預かりしますね。

key: Come back for it later.
en: Come back for it later.
ja: また後で取りに来てくださいね。

key: We can raise two of your Pokémon. Would you like us to raise one more?
en: We can raise two of your Pokémon.  Would you like us to raise one more?
ja: ポケモンは二匹まで預かれますよ。もう一匹、預けますか?

key: Ah, it's good to see you! Your Pokémon can only be doing good!
en: Ah, it's good to see you!  Your Pokémon can only be doing good!
ja: あら、お会いできてうれしいわ! あなたのポケモン、絶好調のはずですよ!

key: Your \v[3]'s level has grown by \v[17].
en: Your \v[3]'s level has grown by \v[17].
ja: \v[3]のレベルが\v[17]上がりました。

key: Oh? It seems your \v[3] learned \v[4] while we were raising it.
en: Oh? It seems your \v[3] learned \v[4] while we were raising it.
ja: あら? \v[3]が預かっている間に\v[4]を覚えたみたいですよ。

key: Will you take your Pokémon back?
en: Will you take your Pokémon back?
ja: ポケモンを引き取りますか?

key: Which one will you take?
en: Which one will you take?
ja: どちらを引き取りますか?

key: If you want your \v[17] back, it will cost $\v[18].
en: If you want your \v[17] back, it will cost $\v[18].
ja: \v[17]を引き取るなら、$\v[18]かかりますよ。

key: You don't have enough money...
en: You don't have enough money...
ja: お金が足りないみたいですね……

key: Perfect. Here's your Pokémon.
en: Perfect. Here's your Pokémon.
ja: はい、どうぞ。ポケモンをお返ししますね。

key: \PN took back \v[17] from the Day-Care Lady.
en: \PN took back \v[17] from the Day-Care Lady.
ja: \PNは預かり屋のおばさんから\v[17]を引き取った。

key: Will you take back the other one too?
en: Will you take back the other one too?
ja: もう一匹の方も引き取りますか?

key: Hello. I am the Day-Care Lady.
en: Hello. I am the Day-Care Lady.
ja: こんにちは。わたしは預かり屋のおばさんです。

key: We can raise your Pokémon. Just leave your Pokémon in our care and it will become stronger than you could have ever imagined.
en: We can raise your Pokémon. Just leave your Pokémon in our care and it will become stronger than you could have ever imagined.
ja: ポケモンを預かって育てて差し上げます。わたしたちに任せてくだされば、想像もしないくらい強くなりますよ。

key: Oh! You're--
en: Oh! You're--
ja: あら! あなたは……

key: Never mind. Um, yes, we're actually closed. Sorry about that.
en: Never mind. Um, yes, we're actually closed. Sorry about that.
ja: いえ、何でもないわ。えっと、実は今日はお休みなんです。ごめんなさいね。

key: I'm sorry, but you simply must go. Come back another day. Or don't!
en: I'm sorry, but you simply must go.  Come back another day. Or don't!
ja: 悪いけど、もう帰ってちょうだい。また別の日にでも……いえ、来なくてもいいわ!

key: You're getting on my nerves! Leave! There's nothing to stick around for!
en: You're getting on my nerves! Leave! There's nothing to stick around for!
ja: 本当に苛立つわね! さっさと出て行きなさい! ここに用なんてないでしょ!

key: DAY-CARE LADY: Uggggh! Fine! You leave us no choice!
en: DAY-CARE LADY: Uggggh! Fine! You leave us no choice!
ja: 預かり屋のおばさん: うぐぐ! わかったわよ! こうなったら仕方ないわね!

key: DAY-CARE MAN: We'll eliminate you ourselves!
en: DAY-CARE MAN: We'll eliminate you ourselves!
ja: 預かり屋のおじさん: 我々自らの手で始末してくれる!

key: DAY-CARE LADY: This is an attack.
en: DAY-CARE LADY: This is an attack.
ja: 預かり屋のおばさん: これは、攻撃。

key: DAY-CARE MAN: So brace for impact.
en: DAY-CARE MAN: So brace for impact.
ja: 預かり屋のおじさん: だから、衝撃に備えろ。

key: DAY-CARE LADY?: To eliminate this infestation!
en: DAY-CARE LADY?: To eliminate this infestation!
ja: 預かり屋のおばさん?: この害虫を排除するため!

key: DAY-CARE MAN?: To restore the art of God's own nation!
en: DAY-CARE MAN?: To restore the art of God's own nation!
ja: 預かり屋のおじさん?: 神の国の芸術を取り戻すため!

key: DAY-CARE LADY?: To break apart the world above!
en: DAY-CARE LADY?: To break apart the world above!
ja: 預かり屋のおばさん?: 上なる世界を打ち砕くため!

key: DAY-CARE MAN?: To find what lies beneath truth and love!
en: DAY-CARE MAN?: To find what lies beneath truth and love!
ja: 預かり屋のおじさん?: 真実と愛の裏にあるものを見つけるため!

key: DAY-CARE COUPLE?: Team Meteor!
en: DAY-CARE COUPLE?: Team Meteor!
ja: 預かり屋の夫婦?: メテオ団!

key: NOT THE DAY-CARE LADY: Resonating with the eternal light!
en: NOT THE DAY-CARE LADY: Resonating with the eternal light!
ja: 預かり屋のおばさんではない: 永遠の光と共に鳴り響け!

key: NOT THE DAY-CARE MAN: Run away now, don't try to fight!
en: NOT THE DAY-CARE MAN: Run away now, don't try to fight!
ja: 預かり屋のおじさんではない: 今すぐ逃げろ、戦おうとするな!

key: DEFINITELY NOT THE DAY-CARE COUPLE: For justice! That's right!
en: DEFINITELY NOT THE DAY-CARE COUPLE: For justice!  That's right!
ja: 絶対に預かり屋の夫婦ではない: 正義のために! そうだ!

key: Ugh, again?!
en: Ugh, again?!
ja: げっ、またかよ?!

key: Hmph.
en: Hmph.
ja: ふんっ。

key: METEOR GRUNT: Yes, I remember you from back at the factory. Why must you always get in the way?!
en: METEOR GRUNT: Yes, I remember you from back at the factory. Why must you always get in the way?!
ja: メテオ団したっぱ: ああ、工場で会ったよな。どうしていつも邪魔してくるんだ?!

key: We've had this ruse up for weeks now... No one suspected that we weren't actually Obsidia Day Care's sweetest elderly couple!
en: We've had this ruse up for weeks now... No one suspected that we weren't actually Obsidia Day Care's sweetest elderly couple!
ja: この変装、もう何週間も続けてきたのに……誰も俺たちがオブシディア預かり屋の優しい老夫婦じゃないなんて気づかなかったのに!

key: Where are the real ones? You'll never know!
en: Where are the real ones? You'll never know!
ja: 本物はどこにいるかって? 絶対に教えてやらないぞ!

key: They're locked up somewhere far away, and you'll never know! Ahaha! Even if you did, you couldn't rescue them- we hid the key somewhere else!
en: They're locked up somewhere far away, and you'll never know! Ahaha! Even if you did, you couldn't rescue them- we hid the key somewhere else!
ja: どこか遠くに閉じ込めてある。お前には絶対わからない! アハハ! たとえわかったところで、助け出せやしない――鍵は別の場所に隠してあるからな!

key: So it's useless!
en: So it's useless!
ja: だから、無駄なんだよ!

key: Well, this was a good way to collect the Pokémon of the more naive Trainers... But we can't have those pesky old people letting Pokémon breed, eh?
en: Well, this was a good way to collect the Pokémon of the more naive Trainers... But we can't have those pesky old people letting Pokémon breed, eh?
ja: まあ、お人好しなトレーナーからポケモンを集めるには、なかなかいい方法だったな……だが、うるさい年寄りどもにポケモンを繁殖させ続けさせるわけにもいかないだろ?

key: Everyone must be eliminated.
en: Everyone must be eliminated.
ja: 全員、排除しなければならない。

key: We do not forgive.
en: We do not forgive.
ja: 我々は許さない。

key: Hello. I am the Day-Care Man.
en: Hello. I am the Day-Care Man.
ja: こんにちは。私は預かり屋のおじさんです。

key: You should leave your Pokémon with my wife.
en: You should leave your Pokémon with my wife.
ja: ポケモンは妻に預けるといい。

key: Wait, aren't you...
en: Wait, aren't you...
ja: 待てよ、お前は……

key: Sorry, it seems we need to close. Have a good day.
en: Sorry, it seems we need to close. Have a good day.
ja: すまないが、今日は閉めなければならないようだ。良い一日を。

key: No, really, you should leave.
en: No, really, you should leave.
ja: いや、本当に、もう帰った方がいい。

key: What part don't you understand? The 'get' or the 'out'?
en: What part don't you understand? The 'get' or the 'out'?
ja: 「出て」の部分がわからないのか、「行け」の部分がわからないのか、どっちだ?

key: DAY-CARE MAN: Uggggh! Fine! You leave us no choice!
en: DAY-CARE MAN: Uggggh! Fine! You leave us no choice!
ja: 預かり屋のおじさん: うぐぐ! わかったよ! こうなったら仕方ない!

key: We'll eliminate you ourselves!
en: We'll eliminate you ourselves!
ja: 我々自らの手で始末してくれる!

key: ASSISTANT: Hi there!
en: ASSISTANT: Hi there!
ja: アシスタント: こんにちは!

key: I'm currently campaigning for funds to support the Day Care!
en: I'm currently campaigning for funds to support the Day Care!
ja: 今、預かり屋を支援するための募金活動をしているんです!

key: The folks here are hoping to order in a fancy machine that many trainers have requested.
en: The folks here are hoping to order in a fancy machine that many trainers have requested.
ja: ここのご夫婦は、多くのトレーナーから要望のあった素敵な機械を注文したいと考えているんですよ。

key: It's something like an Incubator, what will allow eggs to hatch to full with just the press of a button!
en: It's something like an Incubator, what will allow eggs to hatch to full with just the press of a button!
ja: ふ卵器みたいなもので、ボタンひとつでたまごを一気にふ化させられる機械なんです!

key: \GWe still need $ \v[770] in order to purchase it though.
en: \GWe still need $ \v[770] in order to purchase it though.
ja: \Gでも、それを買うにはまだ$ \v[770]必要なんです。

key: Any chance you can donate for it?
en: Any chance you can donate for it?
ja: 少し寄付していただけませんか?

key: ASSISTANT: Wonderful! How much would you like to contribute?
en: ASSISTANT: Wonderful! How much would you like to contribute?
ja: アシスタント: 素晴らしい! いくら寄付してくださいますか?

key: ATTENDANT: Ah, and with that, we finally reach our goal!
en: ATTENDANT: Ah, and with that, we finally reach our goal!
ja: 係員: ああ、それでついに目標達成です!

key: I'll place the order right away.
en: I'll place the order right away.
ja: すぐに注文しますね。

key: Stand back, you wouldn't BELIEVE these delivery times.
en: Stand back, you wouldn't BELIEVE these delivery times.
ja: 下がってて。配達の速さ、信じられないくらいですから。

key: Thanks again!
en: Thanks again!
ja: 本当にありがとうございました!

key: ASSISTANT: Thanks for considering it!
en: ASSISTANT: Thanks for considering it!
ja: アシスタント: 検討してくださってありがとうございます!

key: ASSISTANT: What a generous offer! Thanks for chipping in for the greater good!
en: ASSISTANT: What a generous offer! Thanks for chipping in for the greater good!
ja: アシスタント: なんて気前のいい申し出でしょう! みんなのために協力してくれてありがとうございます!

key: ASSISTANT: Well, I gotta say I appreciate you thinking of us, but you don't even have that much!
en: ASSISTANT: Well, I gotta say I appreciate you thinking of us, but you don't even have that much!
ja: アシスタント: まあ、気にかけてくれるのはうれしいですけど、そんなにお金持ってないじゃないですか!

key: Maybe someday!
en: Maybe someday!
ja: いつか、きっと!

key: The Incubator is warm and raring to go.
en: The Incubator is warm and raring to go.
ja: ふ卵器は温まっていて、今にも動き出しそうだ。

key: What do you want to do?
en: What do you want to do?
ja: どうしますか?

key: Any eggs in the party were sped up to hatch!
en: Any eggs in the party were sped up to hatch!
ja: 手持ちのたまごが、ふ化を早められた!

key: Ah, it's you!
en: Ah, it's you!
ja: あら、あなたね!

key: We were raising your Pokémon, and my goodness, were we surprised!
en: We were raising your Pokémon, and my goodness, were we surprised!
ja: あなたのポケモンを預かっていたんだけど、まあ、本当に驚いたわよ!

key: Your Pokémon was holding an Egg!
en: Your Pokémon was holding an Egg!
ja: あなたのポケモンが、たまごを持っていたの!

key: We don't know how it got there, but your Pokémon had it.
en: We don't know how it got there, but your Pokémon had it.
ja: どうしてそこにあったのかはわからないけど、あなたのポケモンが持っていたのよ。

key: You do want it, don't you?
en: You do want it, don't you?
ja: 欲しいわよね?

key: \PN received the Egg from the Day-Care Man.
en: \PN received the Egg from the Day-Care Man.
ja: \PNは預かり屋のおじさんからたまごを受け取った。

key: You take good care of it.
en: You take good care of it.
ja: ちゃんと大事にしてあげてね。

key: I really will keep it. You do want this Egg, yes?
en: I really will keep it.  You do want this Egg, yes?
ja: 本当にわたしが持っておくわよ。このたまご、欲しいのよね?

key: Well all right then, I'll take it. Thank you.
en: Well all right then, I'll take it. Thank you.
ja: それじゃあ、わたしが持っておくわね。ありがとう。

key: I'm the Day-Care Man.
en: I'm the Day-Care Man.
ja: 私は預かり屋のおじさんです。

key: I help take care of the precious Pokémon of Trainers.
en: I help take care of the precious Pokémon of Trainers.
ja: トレーナーたちの大切なポケモンの世話をしているんですよ。

key: Any Pokémon you'd like to have raised you can leave in my wife's care.
en: Any Pokémon you'd like to have raised you can leave in my wife's care.
ja: 育ててほしいポケモンがいれば、妻に預けるといいでしょう。

key: Ah, it's you!\nGood to see you!
en: Ah, it's you!\nGood to see you!
ja: ああ、あなたか!\nまた会えてうれしいよ!

key: Your \v[3] is doing just fine.
en: Your \v[3] is doing just fine.
ja: \v[3]は元気にしていますよ。

key: Your \v[3] and \v[4] are doing just fine.
en: Your \v[3] and \v[4] are doing just fine.
ja: \v[3]と\v[4]は元気にしていますよ。

key: The two play with other Pokémon rather than with each other...
en: The two play with other Pokémon rather than with each other...
ja: 二匹は、お互いよりも他のポケモンと遊んでいるみたいで……

key: The two don't seem to like each other much.
en: The two don't seem to like each other much.
ja: 二匹はあまり仲が良くないようですね。

key: The two seem to get along.
en: The two seem to get along.
ja: 二匹は仲良くしているようですよ。

key: The two seem to get along very well.
en: The two seem to get along very well.
ja: 二匹はとても仲良くしているようですね。

key: Yes
en: Yes
ja: はい

key: No
en: No
ja: いいえ

key: Wait for Egg
en: Wait for Egg
ja: たまごを待つ

key: Hatch Eggs
en: Hatch Eggs
ja: たまごをかえす

key: Cancel
en: Cancel
ja: やめる
